title: Mandu - City of Joy
overview: Escape the city and experience the beauty of Mandav, the City of Joy. Explore magnificent forts, historic monuments, breathtaking viewpoints, and seasonal waterfalls while enjoying delicious local cuisine with a fun-filled group journey.

itinerary.title: Explore the Historic City of Mandav
activities: Early morning departure from Indore from the selected pickup point.
Enjoy a delicious breakfast on the way.
Reach Mandav and begin exploring its magnificent historical monuments.
Visit Jahaz Mahal, Hindola Mahal, Baz Bahadur Palace, Rani Roopmati Pavilion, and Rewa Kund.
Capture stunning photographs at scenic viewpoints and enjoy seasonal waterfalls during the monsoon.
Relish an authentic Dal Bafla lunch.
Spend leisure time exploring the beauty of Mandav before starting the return journey.
Reach Indore by evening with unforgettable memories.

exclusions: Snacks, beverages & meals that is not mentioned

policies.title: Cancellation Policy
policies.content: If cancellations are made 60-30 days before the trip's start date, 10% of the total tour cost will be charged as cancellation fees. If cancellations are made 30 days before the trip's start date, 50% of the total tour cost will be charged as cancellation fees. If cancellations are made within 0-30 days before the trip's start date, 100% of the total tour cost will be charged as cancellation fees. In case of unforeseen weather conditions or government restrictions, certain activities may be canceled, and in such cases, the operator will try his best to provide an alternate feasible activity. However, no refund will be provided for the same.
